-rwxr-xr-x 1 root root 75 Oct 18 17:38 .git/hooks/pre-commit
---
#!/bin/sh
test "${HK:-1}" = "0" || exec hk run commit-msg --from-hook "$@"
---
original-rechner dep:
present
    "original-rechner": "git+https://gitlab.opencode.de/digitalservicebund/elterngeldrechner-legacy.git#69ad27a02bb5105e10890338845cf21b727a0c27",

observation.command: cd /workspace; ls -la .git/hooks/pre-commit .git/hooks/commit-msg; echo ---; cat .git/hooks/commit-msg; echo ---; echo "original-rechner dep:"; ls node_modules/original-rechner >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "present" || echo "missing"; git show HEAD:package.json | grep original-rechner
